title: Product & Category Analyst / Market Research Specialist
description:
E-commerce on Bol · Remote · 3–4 days a week to start, growing as the role does



We're a Dutch e-commerce business selling on the Bol marketplace, and we're growing fast. A big part of that growth comes down to one hard question, asked over and over: what should we launch next, and what should we leave alone? 

Most people get this wrong. They chase trends, ignore the margin, and miss the products that quietly print money. 

We're looking for the person who gets it right more often than not.



This isn't a research-assistant job. 

You won't be filling in sheets someone else acts on. 

You'll be the one finding the opportunities, weighing them honestly, and putting your name to a recommendation. 

You'd work directly with me, the founder, alongside our data analyst and purchasing team. 

You bring the thinking, we d
 together, and you watch your calls play out in the business.



What you'd be doing

There are three sides to this role.



Finding new products to launch. This is the heart of the job. We aim to launch around five new product keywords a month (each one usually having 2-3 SKUs). 

You'd hunt for those opportunities, run them through clear criteria, and bring me a short, well-argued case for each one worth pursuing. 

You'd also check the sourcing data our purchasing team gathers, so we're confident the numbers behind a launch actually hold up.



Growing what we already sell. 

Looking at our existing products and finding ways to do better, a smart addition to a product family, a sharper price, better quality, a stronger look. 

You'd spot where we can extend or improve an offer and make the case for it.



Trends and seasonality. 

Keeping an eye on where the market's heading, and working closely with our data analyst to flag seasonal swings before they hit, Q4 build-ups, summer or winter spikes on certain SKUs, and which categories are growing or shrinking year on year. 

Your job is to make sure we're never caught off guard on timing.





How we think about a good product

We have criteria, and part of your job is to apply them sharply: enough demand to be worth it, competition we can realistically beat, and margin that still works after all marketplace costs and sourcing. Those are the filters. 

The judgment, which of the products that clear those filters is actually worth launching, is the part we're hiring you for. 

We can teach you our thresholds. 

We can't teach instinct, so that's what we'll be looking for, and we'll know quickly whether you have it.



Who we're hoping to find

Real e-commerce and marketplace research experience. (at least 3 years / preferably 5+) 

You've done product research for an online business before, ideally on a marketplace like Bol, Amazon, or similar marketplaces. 

You understand how demand, competition, reviews, pricing, and fulfilment costs come together to make a product win or lose.

Judgment that's been proven, not just claimed. 

Anyone can pull numbers and call something "trending." We need someone who looks at a category and knows which gap is a real opportunity and which is a trap that'll cost us money. 

If you've actually launched or recommended products that worked, that's what we want to hear about.



Comfortable with the tools. 

Bol's own data, marketplace research tools (Helium 10, Keepa, or similar specific for Bol like Marktmentor), and AI tools for speeding up research and analysis. 

If you already lean on AI to work faster and sharper, you'll fit right in.



A close collaborator. 

You'll work hand in hand with our data analyst and purchasing team, so you need to communicate clearly and share what you find in a way others can act on.

Fully fluent English, happy working remotely with a few hours of daily overlap with European time.



What you get out of it

-Real ownership. You're not a research assistant filling sheets, you own product discovery and shape what we launch. Your work is visible in the business fast.



-A direct line to the founder. You bring the opportunities, we d
 together, and you see your calls play out.



-Room to grow. This starts at 3–4 days a week and can grow with the company as our launch pace picks up.



-A company that invests in you. We're built on quality, in our products, our service, and the life of our team. We back that with a monthly health bonus you can put toward whatever keeps you well, gym, better sleep, whatever works for you.



-Remote, wherever you are, with just a few hours of daily overlap with European time.



-USD $15 an hour to start, with real room to move up as you prove yourself.





How to apply

Skip the long CV for now. Instead, I'd like to see how you actually work.



Pick any product category you like and find me three products you'd consider worth launching on a marketplace. 



For each one, tell me briefly why, what makes you think there's a real opportunity, and what would make you nervous about it. 

I'm not expecting it to match our business perfectly, I want to see how you spot and weigh an opportunity.



Then tell me a little about your background in e-commerce research, and what made you want this role specifically.



One last thing. 

We're after real A-players, and A-players like to work with other A-players. 

So if you've read this and thought "yes, this is me", apply. I'm looking forward to seeing what you find.

title: Python / FFmpeg Automation Developer for Football Video Repackaging System
description:
I’m building a football short-for
dia system and I’m looking for a technical automation developer to help me build a local video repackaging tool.



This is NOT a manual video editing role.

This is NOT a CapCut editor role.

I’m looking for someone technical who can build automation.



The first goal is to build a local tool that runs on my Windows computer and automatically turns football videos into Instagram Reel-style videos using a fixed template.



The tool should:



- Take source videos from a folder

- Read title text from a CSV file or Google Sheet

- Create 1080x1920 MP4 videos

- Add a black background

- Add a large white title at the top

- Place / crop / resize the original video below the title

- Preserve the original audio

- Export final videos to an output folder

- Process many videos in batch

- Organize output files by date / account

- Create logs for successful and failed renders



After the first version works, we will continue building more automation:



- Google Sheets integration

- Google Drive upload

- AI title / caption generation

- n8n workflows

- Source monitoring

- Multiple video templates

- High-volume daily video processing



Required skills:



- Python or Node.js

- FFmpeg

- Video automation

- Batch processing

- Working with files and folders

- Google Sheets / Google Drive API is a big plus

- n8n experience is a plus

- OpenAI / Claude API experience is a plus



Work structure:



We will start with a paid 1-week probation period.

The goal of the first week is to build the first working MVP:



- Input folder with videos

- CSV with filename + title

- Output 1080x1920 MP4

- Black background

- Title at the top

- Source video centered below

- Original audio preserved

- Batch processing



If the first week goes well, this can become ongoing part-time work.



Please do not apply if you are only a manual video editor.

I’m looking for a technical automation developer, not a CapCut editor.



To apply, please start your message with the word FFMPEG and answer these questions:

3. How would you create the first version of this tool?

description:
Direct Response Print Designer (US Nutraceutical / Magalog / Direct Mail)



Description:



We are looking for a highly experienced, creative, and conversion-focused direct response print designer for a US nutraceutical / supplement marketing business.



This is NOT a branding project.

This is NOT modern web / startup design.

This is NOT social media creative.



We are specifically looking for someone who understands direct response conversion design for print and can bring fresh ideas to existing concepts.



Our target audience is US seniors (60+), so readability, trust, hierarchy, and intuitive information flow are absolutely critical.



You should have experience designing:



* Magalogs

* Direct mail packages

* Sales letters

* Order forms

* Retention letters

* Parcel inserts



What we need:



We have an existing direct mail concept that needs to be completely reworked and redesigned.



The objective is to transform the current concept into a much stronger direct response package with its own visual identity.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions.



We are looking for a creative designer who can challenge existing layouts, improve the reader experience, develop stronger visual concepts, and contribute ideas that improve conversion performance.



Important:



This is conversion-focused print design.



We care far more about:



* Readability

* Visual trust

* Left-to-right reading flow

* Page pacing

* Hierarchy

* Senior-friendly layouts

* Direct response psychology



Than about:



* Trendy aesthetics

* Flashy design

* Minimalist branding



This audience is older, so the design must be:



* Simple

* Intuitive

* Easy to read

* Visually structured

* Comfortable to consume

* Built to guide the reader naturally through the offer



For the initial test:

title: Expert Media Buyer - Google Ads & Meta Ads : 400 - 800 USD/mo - Facebook &amp
description:
OVERVIEW



RMD is a digital agency with clients in 20+ countries. We're hiring a Media Buyer to own paid acquisition on Google Ads and Meta Ads -
 & Instagram ads -, from setup to the part most people skip: making the campaigns actually work.



This is not a "launch it and check back next week" seat. We need someone who treats every account like their own money is in it. You build the campaign, yes, but more importantly you read the numbers every day, find what's leaking, and fix it before the client has to ask.



This is also not a junior seat where we hold your hand. We want someone ahead of us on paid media. Someone who teaches the team, raises the standard, and keeps learning every single day on their own. If you're the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when a campaign is spending without a clear answer on why it's converting (or why it isn't), this is for you.



Compensation: $400 to $800 USD per month based on experience and proven results, paid via PayPal. Top performers move up fast. See the pay-growth section below.



Hours: 40 hours per week, Manila time. We need 4 hours of overlap with Morocco/Dubai (so a 1pm to 9pm or 2pm to 10pm Manila shift is ideal).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Plan, build, and launch Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen) and Meta Ads (Advantage+, traffic/conversion campaigns) from a brief, with clean account structure, correct conversion goals, and sane budgets

- Create clear, detailed briefs for ad creatives — concept, angle, hook, format, copy direction, and reference — so designers and video editors can execute without guessing

- Strategize for clients, not just execute. Own the account-level plan: funnel structure, offer/angle testing roadmap, budget allocation across channels, and where to scale next

- Run benchmarks. Pull and track performance against industry and account baselines (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, CVR) so every result has a "good vs. bad" reference, not a number in a vacuum

- Own performance daily. Watch spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and frequency. Catch problems within hours, not at month-end

- Run campaigns in multiple languages. Our clients span Morocco, Dubai, France, and beyond. You use AI and translation tools to localize ad copy, keywords, and audiences quickly and correctly, then sanity-check the output before it goes live

- Set up and verify tracking properly: Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 events, consent mode v2, and confirm the data is actually firing and matching, not "the pixel is green, ship it"

- Run weekly account-health checks: disapproved ads, broken conversion tracking, audience overlap, budget pacing, wasted spend on junk placements and search terms. Flag what you find with a recommendation, not just a list

- Write the analysis. Every report answers: what happened, why, what you're doing about it, what you need from us. No vanity metrics. We don't care about impressions and "engagement" if the leads or sales aren't moving

- Build and follow repeatable processes: launch checklists, naming conventions, weekly optimization routines, reporting templates. If you do something twice, it should become a documented process

- Run structured tests: creative tests, audience tests, bid strategy tests, landing page angle tests. One variable, clear hypothesis, real read on the result

- Manage budgets responsibly and scale what works without torching CPA

- Teach the team. Share what you know, document your playbooks, and level up the people around you

- Communicate async, in writing, with the numbers attached



WHAT YOU NEED ON DAY ONE



The floor on this role is real. You walk in with these or you don't walk in.



- 2+ years managing live Google Ads AND Meta Ads accounts. Not a course, not a sandbox. Real accounts with real spend that you were responsible for and held accountable for

- You are genuinely analytical and great with numbers. You can look at a performance table and immediately see where the money is going wrong. CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, frequency, AOV are not jargon to you, they're the tools you think with

- You can write ad creative briefs and set creative direction. You know what makes a hook stop the scroll and can brief a designer or editor so they execute without guessing

- You think strategy, not just execution. You can build an account-level plan: funnel, offers/angles to test, budget split across channels, and a clear point of view on where to scale

- Pixel and conversion tracking setup. Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tags, GA4. You've installed them, debugged them, and confirmed events fire correctly (Events Manager, Tag Assistant, GA4 DebugView)

- Consent Mode v2 experience. You understand why it matters for EU tracking and have implemented or worked with it

- You create and follow processes. You don't rely on memory. You build checklists and routines and you stick to them

- You run ads in multiple languages. You're comfortable using AI and translation tools to localize campaigns for different markets, and you know how to check that the localized copy is actually good and not robotic

- Recent performance screenshots are a MUST. Send real, recent (last 6 months) screenshots from Ads Manager, Google Ads, or GA4 showing accounts you managed: spend, CPA/ROAS, results over time. Redacted client names are fine. No screenshots, no shortlist

- Killer analysis, not vanity metrics. When you send those screenshots, tell us the story: what was broken, what you changed, what happened. "We lowered CPA from $42 to $19 by cutting X and restructuring Y" beats "we got 2M impressions"

- You care about client results like an owner. You're not satisfied when the campaign is "running." You're satisfied when it's winning. People who set up campaigns and walk away are not who we want

- You self-train every day. Paid media changes constantly. Platforms ship updates, policies shift, what worked last quarter dies. We expect you to do your own daily learning to stay ahead, not wait for us to teach you. You should be the one bringing new tactics to the table

- You read English well. Our briefs and reports are in English

- Honesty about what you don't know. "I haven't run PMax much, but I've run a lot of Search and I learn fast" beats "yes I know everything" followed by a blown budget



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT MOVES YOU UP THE LIST)



- An account where you can show a clear before/after: CPA down, ROAS up, or scale without losing efficiency, with the GA4/Ads Manager screenshots to prove it

- Experience scaling an account past $10K/month in spend profitably

- E-commerce / Shopify paid media (we have e-commerce clients)

- Lead-gen experience with offline/CRM conversion tracking

- Server-side tracking (sGTM, CAPI Gateway) experience

- Google Tag Manager fluency

- French (we have clients in France and North Africa)

- Comfortable recording Loom walkthroughs of an account to explain your thinking async



WHO WE ARE



A small team distributed across Morocco and Dubai. We work in writing, async-first, and we trust people to ship and to own the number.



We use AI in the daily work, in media buying, in copy, and in translation. We expect you to use it too, fluently, after onboarding. The test for this role does not allow AI, because we need to see how YOU read an account and make decisions.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT (read this part carefully)



This is a seat with a high ceiling for someone who is already strong and keeps getting stronger. Here's what that means:



- You will get to do more, fast. If you can build clean campaigns and actually move the numbers, we hand you more accounts, bigger budgets, and a real say in strategy. We don't make good media buyers babysit one account forever.

- We reward results. Drop a CPA, scale a winning account, save a campaign we thought was dead, and we adjust your pay and scope to match. We don't make people wait 2 years for a real raise. A-players see significant pay growth (50% to 80%+) inside the first year.

- You set the standard, and we back it. We want someone who pushes us forward on paid media, brings us new tactics, and teaches the team. If you do that, you get more ownership, not more oversight.

- The ceiling is what you make of it. Our best media buyers grow into account strategists and paid media leads who own client relationships and budgets. You d
 how fast.



Who this is NOT for: people who set up a campaign, send a screenshot of impressions, and call it a day. People who get nervous reading a numbers table. People who wait to be taught instead of teaching themselves. If comfortable, low-pressure, and no growth is the goal, this isn't the seat. Apply somewhere else, no hard feelings.



HOW TO APPLY



- Reply with your CV

- Include recent performance screenshots (last 6 months) from accounts you've managed: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and/or GA4. Show spend and results over time. Redacted client/brand names are fine. This is required, not optional

- Start your
 body with the line: RMD RMD. (Yes, exactly those two words on the first line. This is how we know you actually read the post.)

- In the
, confirm you read this full brief and confirm the exact monthly pay you're looking for (in USD). Be specific, not a range

- Tell us in 2 to 3 sentences: what's the most recent account you managed? What was broken or underperforming, what did you change, and what was the measurable result?

- If your application makes our shortlist, we send you a free 45-minute practical test (we'll show you the scoring before you start). Expect to read a real account's numbers and tell us what you'd do

- We reply within 5 business days if we want to move you forward. We're a small team with no dedicated recruiter. If you don't hear from us in that window, it wasn't a fit this round. Don't take it personally and please don't chase. We respect your time enough to be honest about that.



WHAT NOT TO SEND



- A CV with no performance screenshots

- Vanity metrics (impressions, reach, "engagement") with no link to leads or sales

- "I am hardworking and loyal" cover letters with no numbers

- Promises that you can do everything and scale anything (we know nobody can)



We're hiring one person for this role. We're patient. We will wait for the right fit.



Apply on OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 with subject "Media Buyer PH, [Your Full Name]"

- Previous experience with image annotation, data labeling, or similar tasks

- Fully remote, work from home

- Long-term, stable position, not a one-off project

- Full training provided on our annotation tools, no prior annotation experience required

- Opportunity to grow into QA reviewer or team lead as the team expands

description:

We are looking for an experienced **Google Merchant Center (GMC) Approval Expert** who specializes in getting **Shopify dropshipping stores approved** for Google Merchant Center and Google Shopping.



**IMPORTANT:** To be considered, start your application with the words **"GMC Approval"**. Applications that do not include these words at the beginning will be automatically ignored.

  * Misrepresentation policy violations

  * Account suspensions

  * Product disapprovals

  * Product feeds

  * Shipping and return policies

We are looking for a long-term partner with proven GMC approval experience who can consistently help us get Shopify dropshipping stores approved and compliant for the US and European markets.

title: Office Administration Assistant
description:
Full-Time Virtual Office Administrator & Quote Conversion Coordinator



Industry: Air Conditioning, HVAC Services, Property Management & Facilities

Location: Remote / Work From Home — Australia-facing role

Employment Type: Full-Time Virtual Role

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance-based commission on successful quote conversions



About KleenAir



KleenAir is a fast-growing, premium air conditioning, HVAC hygiene, servicing, repair and installation company proudly servicing South East Queensland.



We work with homeowners, tenants, property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, schools, aged care providers, facilities managers and businesses across Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast and surrounding areas.



Our services include split system deep cleaning, ducted air conditioning cleaning and servicing, mould and hygiene-related air conditioning work, breakdown assistance, repairs, maintenance, system replacements and installations.



We are a professional, Australian-owned business with high standards around customer communication, quoting, scheduling, reporting and follow-up. We are now looking for a capable full-time virtual tea
mber who can support our office operations and help convert enquiries and quotes into confirmed jobs.



The Role



This is not a basic admin role where you wait to be told what to do every hour.



We need someone proactive, organised, well-spoken and confident enough to manage daily administrative tasks, customer communication, quote follow-ups and booking coordination with minimal hand-holding once trained.



You will be working remotely, but you must be able to operate with the same discipline, urgency and professionalism expected in a busy Australian office environment.



Your role will be a mix of:



Office administration

Customer communication

Quote follow-up

Booking coordination

CRM and pipeline updates

 and phone support

Sales support and conversion tracking

Internal coordination with the operations team



Your main objective will be simple:



Keep the office workflow moving, keep customers informed, and make sure no enquiry or quote is forgotten.



Key Responsibilities

Customer Communication



You will communicate with customers, tenants, property managers, real estate agencies and commercial clients by phone,
 and messaging.



You must be able to write and speak in clear, professional English.



You will be expected to:



Respond to customer enquiries professionally

Follow up on outstanding quotes

Explain service inclusions clearly

Answer basic questions about bookings, quotes and service scope

Reassure customers and guide them through the next step

Escalate technical questions to the correct internal person

Maintain a calm, polite and professional tone at all times

Quote Follow-Up & Conversion



A major part of this role will involve quote follow-up.



Our business sends detailed quotes for air conditioning cleaning, servicing, repairs and installation work. Your job will be to ensure these quotes are followed up properly and professionally.



You will be responsible for:



Calling and
ing customers after quotes are sent

Tracking quote status in the CRM

Identifying hot leads and urgent opportunities

Following up without sounding robotic or desperate

Helping customers understand value, inclusions and urgency

Converting approved quotes into confirmed booking requests

Recording all follow-up notes accurately

Reporting on quote outcomes and next actions



This is not cold calling. These are warm enquiries and issued quotes. However, you must be comfortable making outbound calls and following up consistently.



Booking & Scheduling Support



You will assist with coordinating bookings and making sure customer requirements are clearly passed on to the operations team.



This may include:



Confirming customer details

Checking preferred appointment windows

Recording access notes

Noting tenant, property manager or site contact details

Communicating special instructions

Helping the office team keep the schedule organised

Ensuring approved jobs are handed over properly for booking

CRM, Admin & Reporting



You must be comfortable working with online systems, CRMs, spreadsheets,
 platforms and basic business software.



Your daily responsibilities may include:



Updating customer records

Maintaining quote pipelines

Recording follow-up attempts and outcomes

Preparing daily task summaries

Flagging urgent leads or overdue follow-ups

Keeping admin records clean and accurate

Assisting with internal reporting

Helping improve office processes over time



Accuracy matters. We do not want messy notes, forgotten follow-ups or vague updates.



Property Management & Trade Care Support



KleenAir works closely with real estate agencies, property managers and trade care clients.



Experience dealing with Australian property management, trades, maintenance, facilities or service-based businesses will be highly regarded.



You may assist with:



Following up property manager approvals

Handling tenant access details

Communicating job status updates

Sending or tracking service reports

Supporting recurring agency clients

Helping ensure real estate jobs are handled professionally

What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is reliable, switched-on and genuinely capable.



You must have:



Strong spoken and written English

Previous experience working for an Australian business

Strong administrative skills

Confidence speaking with customers by phone

Ability to follow up without needing constant reminders

Good attention to detail

Professional
 writing ability

Strong organisation and time management

Ability to work independently from home

A stable internet connection and quiet working environment

Confidence using CRM systems,
, spreadsheets and online tools



You should be the type of person who sees what needs to be done and takes action, rather than waiting for someone to give you instructions every hour.



Experience Highly Regarded



Experience in any of the following will be highly regarded:



Australian trade services businesses

Air conditioning, HVAC, plumbing, electrical or maintenance companies

Real estate or property management support

Facilities management administration

Customer service for an Australian company

Sales administration or quote follow-up

Virtual assistant roles for Australian businesses

CRM and pipeline management

Phone-based customer service or sales support

Performance & Rewards



We believe good people should be rewarded for good results.



This role includes:



Competitive base salary

Performance-based commission on successful quote conversions

Opportunity to grow with the business

Clear expectations and measurable outcomes

Long-term role for the right person



Commission may be based on:



Quotes converted into confirmed jobs

Revenue secured

Successful follow-up outcomes

Upsells or service upgrades where appropriate



The better you perform, the more you can earn.



Who This Role Is NOT For



Please do not apply if:



You are not confident speaking and writing in English

You need to be reminded constantly to complete basic tasks

You are uncomfortable making phone calls

You have no experience working with Australian customers or businesses

You are disorganised or careless with details

You rely only on scripts and cannot think for yourself

You are applying with an exaggerated or made-up resume

You are not serious about a full-time work-from-home role



We are happy to train the right person on our systems and services, but we are not looking for someone who needs basic professionalism, communication or work ethic taught from scratch.



Important Note



We verify experience during the interview process.



If your resume lists skills or experience that you cannot confidently discuss or demonstrate, this will usually become clear very quickly. Please do not waste your time or ours by applying with inaccurate, exaggerated or copied information.



We are looking for someone genuine, capable and ready to contribute.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:



Your updated resume

A short cover letter explaining your previous experience with Australian businesses

Details of any admin, CRM, customer service, quote follow-up or sales experience

A brief explanation of why you believe you would be suitable for this role



In your application, please also answer the following:



Have you worked for an Australian business before? If yes, what type of business?

Are you comfortable making outbound follow-up calls?

What CRM,
 or admin systems have you used before?

How do you organise your daily workload when working remotely?

What makes you reliable in a work-from-home role?



We are looking for someone who is professional, proactive, detail-focused and confident communicating with Australian customers.



If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. This isn't a role for someone who just follows a script; we need a problem-solver who understands the "why" behind Amazon’s rules and knows how to navigate them effectively. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.



Key Responsibilities

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly. 



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.



Operational Support: General administrative tasks related to the Amazon storefront to ensure "everything is just handled."



The Ideal Candidate

The "Amazon Veteran": You’ve been inside Seller Central long enough to know that "The Rules" and "How things actually work" are often two different things.



Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.



English Fluency: Excellent written English is a must for both customer service and drafting persuasive appeals to Amazon.



Technical Requirements

Proven experience with Amazon Seller Central (specifically Account Health and Case Logs).



Experience handling "difficult" compliance or reinstatement issues is a major plus.



Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

description:
About Us

We are a Hong Kong-based technology company specializing in cutting-edge AI engine solutions and AI-powered consumer services. Our clients span across international markets, and we are building a high-performance remote team to accelerate global business growth.

We are not looking for just anyone — we are looking for someone exceptional who thinks in numbers, not just in feelings.



Role: B2B Sales & Business Development Specialist



Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based)

Salary: PHP 96,000/month (fixed) + performance incentive

Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday (flexible, aligned to HK/global client time zones)



What You Will Do:

- Conduct outbound prospecting via
, LinkedIn, and video calls to international B2B clients

- Qualify leads and schedule high-value discovery calls / demos for senior stakeholders

- Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through to close

- Maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM (HubSpot or equivalent)

- Track and analyze your own performance data weekly: outreach volume, reply rate, conversion rate, win rate — and adjust your approach based on what the numbers show

Identify funnel bottlenecks using data, form clear hypotheses, and run experiments to improve them

- Research target accounts, market trends, and competitor activity

- Support marketing campaigns and business development initiatives





Our Core Philosophy: Quantitative Before Qualitative

At our company, every business problem is first analyzed with numbers.

? "I feel the campaign isn't working well." — this is NOT analysis.

? "Reply rate dropped from 4.2% to 1.8% week-over-week, likely caused by the subject line change on Tuesday." — this IS analysis.

If you cannot define problems with data, you cannot solve them. We need someone who naturally reaches for numbers when something feels off, and who has actually done this in previous roles — not just heard about it.



Requirements — Must Have

- Graduate of a recognized university (you MUST include your university and degree in your application)

- Business-level English — written and spoken. You will be assessed during the interview

- Proven, hands-on experience analyzing sales or marketing performance using quantitative metrics — you have personally tracked KPIs, diagnosed problems through numbers, and acted on those insights in a real work setting

- Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets), funnel metrics (conversion rates, drop-off rates), and basic statistical thinking (averages, ratios, trends)

- Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Strong reporting habits — you proactively flag issues before they become problems

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment





Nice to Have (Strong Advantage)

- Experience in BPO, multinational, or foreign-client-facing roles

- Outbound sales track record (cold
 / LinkedIn outreach / calling) with measurable results you can quote (e.g., "lifted reply rate from 1.5% to 3.8% over 6 weeks")

- CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) — including building reports or dashboards

- Closing experience with quotable numbers (e.g., "achieved 120% of quota in Q3")

- Exposure to tech, SaaS, or AI-related industries



Please Do NOT Apply If:

- You analyze problems primarily through "feelings" or "general impressions" rather than numbers

- You have never personally tracked your own KPIs or pulled data to diagnose a sales/marketing problem in your previous role

- You expect your manager to identify problems for you — we need someone who finds them first, with data

- You cannot provide proof of your university degree when requested

- Your English communication is primarily written-only with limited spoken fluency

- You require constant supervision to complete tasks

- You are looking for a purely task-execution role with no ownership



If we have to do the analytical thinking for you, hiring you defeats the purpose. Please be honest with yourself before applying.



How to Apply — IMPORTANT: Read carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

To apply, please send your application to 
] with the subject line exactly as written:

"AI Sales – [Your Full Name] – [Your University]"

Your application MUST include all of the following:

1. Your resume / CV (PDF format)

2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introduction (link required — see instructions below)

3. Answers to ALL FOUR screening questions below (in the body of your
)



Loom Video Instructions

Record a short 2–3 minute video at 
 (free) where you:

- Introduce yourself in English (name, university, degree, years of experience)

- Describe one specific situation where you used data or numbers to identify a problem at work — what were the numbers, what did you conclude, and what did you do? (vague answers will be rejected)

- Tell us: What does "working independently" mean to you in practice?



Screening Questions (answer all 4 in your
)

Q1. Which university did you graduate from, and what was your degree?

Q2. Describe a time you had to reach a decision or solve a problem at work without clear instructions from your manager. What did you do, and what was the result?

Q3. Have you used a CRM tool before? If yes, which one, and how did you use it specifically in your sales or BD role? Please include any numbers (e.g., pipeline value managed, conversion rates tracked, deals closed).

Q4. (Quantitative Analysis Case — please answer with numbers)

Imagine you sent 500 cold
s last month and received the following results:



Open rate: 38% (industry average: 40%)

Reply rate: 1.2% (industry average: 3%)

Booked appointments: 2

Closed deals: 0



Based on these numbers alone:

(a) Where is the biggest bottleneck in the funnel, and why? Cite specific numbers in your reasoning.

Applications missing the Loom video, incorrect subject line, or incomplete answers — especially Q4 with vague non-numerical reasoning — will be automatically filtered out.

s on my behalf. I will teach you how to do this.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist
description:
About Economic Impact Catalyst

Economic Impact Catalyst (EIC) is an outcomes platform company that powers entrepreneurial ecosystems across the United States and beyond. In Year 8, we have served 100,000+ small business owners, facilitated $200M+ to underrepresented entrepreneurs, and powered 200+ programs through our Catalyzer platform.

We are a distributed team operating across the US, Philippines, India, and Mexico. Collaboration, accountability, and mission alignment are at the core of how we work.

The Role

The Sales Enablement Specialist is the operational backbone of EIC's revenue team. Your job is to make the sales team more effective by owning the systems, content, and research infrastructure that keeps the pipeline moving.

The best sales enablement professionals understand that their job is not to do sales — it is to remove every obstacle that stops a salesperson from selling. If our reps are doing research when they should be calling, you fix that. If a proposal template is missing, you build it. If HubSpot is messy, you clean it. Your output is measured in rep productivity, not in your own activity.

What You Will Do

HubSpot and CRM Operations

• Own HubSpot data hygiene: contact records, deal stages, pipeline accuracy, and activity logging standards

• Build and maintain sequence templates,
 templates, and outreach cadences for the sales team

• Create and maintain HubSpot dashboards that give the team real-time pipeline visibility

• Audit pipeline weekly: flag stale deals, incomplete MEDDIC data, and missing next steps

Sales Research and Prospecting Support

• Build verified, ICP-matched prospect lists using Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalent tools

• Monitor and flag buying triggers: SSBCI grant announcements, CDFI certifications, new SBDC director appointments, grant renewal windows

• Research target accounts before outreach: funding sources, current technology, leadership contacts, recent news

• Maintain the Tier 1/2/3 account list in HubSpot and update it weekly based on new intelligence

Sales Collateral and Content

• Maintain the GTM playbook in Notion: keep objection library, discovery scripts, demo scripts, and proposal templates current

• Build and update proposal templates for each buyer segment (SBDC, CDFI, EDO, corporate foundation)

• Create one-pagers, competitive displacement guides, and ROI calculators as directed

• Draft first-pass blog posts, webinar outlines, and LinkedIn content using AI tools for rep review and publication

AI Tool Operations

• Run AI-assisted research workflows for account prep and outreach personalization using Claude, Perplexity, or equivalent

• Transcribe and summarize discovery and demo calls using Otter.ai or Fireflies; deliver summaries to HubSpot within 24 hours

• Manage the team's AI tool stack: ensure licenses are active, workflows are documented, and reps know how to use each tool

Webinar and Newsletter Operations

• Manage the logistics of monthly webinars: registration page, confirmation
s, reminder sequences, attendee export to HubSpot

• Tag and segment webinar attendees in HubSpot by topic and urgency signal for rep follow-up

• Support the EIC newsletter: compile content, format, schedule, and track engagement data

• Export newsletter engagement signals (repeated opens, link clicks) to HubSpot for rep outreach prioritization

Reporting and Metrics

• Produce weekly pipeline reports: deals advanced, proposals sent, demos completed, stale deals flagged

• Monitor brand visibility across AI search surfaces (ChatGPT, Perplexity, and equivalent) and report monthly

• Track and report software review platform presence monthly against target

What We Are Looking For

Required

• 2–4 years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, or revenue operations in a B2B SaaS environment

• Proficiency in HubSpot (CRM, sequences, pipelines, dashboards). HubSpot certification is a strong plus.

• Experience building prospect lists and running outbound research workflows (Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalent)

• Strong English writing ability: you will be drafting
s, proposals, playbook content, and collateral for a US audience

• Comfort with AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or equivalent. You are not afraid to learn new tools.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-directed. You can manage multiple priorities without daily oversight.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience supporting a distributed US-based sales team from a remote international location

• Familiarity with economic development, nonprofit program management, or the SBDC/CDFI/EDO sector (or ability to learn quickly)

• Experience with Notion for knowledge management and playbook documentation

• Experience with webinar platforms (Zoom Webinars) and
 marketing tools

• Experience with call transcription tools (Otter.ai, Fireflies, or equivalent)

Working Arrangements

Location: Remote — Philippines or India (both locations welcome to apply)

Time zone overlap: Minimum 4 hours overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) required for team syncs

Hours: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Communication: Slack, HubSpot, Notion, Zoom. Fluent English required.

Equipment: EIC provides equipment or equipment allowance per company policy

Why EIC

• Work with a mission-driven company that has a proven 8-year track record and real, measurable impact in underserved communities

• Join a distributed team that genuinely values international talent and has established infrastructure in the Philippines and India

• Own a real function — this is not a data entry role. You will build systems, create content, and directly affect revenue outcomes.

• Learn the full B2B SaaS GTM stack: HubSpot, AI tools, outbound methodology, content strategy, and product-led sales

• Work with a fast-moving, scrappy team where your contributions are visible and valued

How to Apply

Send your resume and a brief note (3–5 sentences) answering this question: Describe the most impactful thing you did to help a sales team close more deals. What did you build, fix, or create — and what was the result?

Applications without the note will not be reviewed. We are looking for people who understand enablement, not just administration.

title: Meta / Facebook / Instagram Ads - Campaign Manager
description:
Meta ads campaign manager

 Part-time contractor | Remote | Set hourly rate

 

MUST READ IN FULL TO APPLY

About us

Venture to Bloom is a content studio based in Maryland, USA. We run pop-up content creation days for entrepreneurs and small business owners in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area, and we work with consultants, coaches, and business teams to produce video and photo content that drives revenue. We're in growth mode and ready to start running paid ads that actually convert.



The role

We need an experienced Meta ads specialist to first help us diagnose and resolve an issue with our Meta business account setup, then build and manage campaigns from the ground up. This is a set hourly rate engagement with consistent weekly hours and potential for long-term partnership as we scale.

You'll be our go-to person for all things Meta. That means you're not just running ads; you're thinking through the full funnel and making sure every dollar we spend has a job to do.



What you'll be doing

Account audit and setup (first priority):

Diagnosing why our Meta business account isn't properly configured for Venture to Bloom and resolving it. This may involve verifying the business, troubleshooting Business Manager or Ad Account permissions, and determining whether Meta support contact is needed. We need this sorted before anything else can move forward.



Ongoing campaign management:

Installing and verifying the Meta Pixel on our website and landing pages. Building custom audiences from our
 list, website visitors, and Instagram followers. Creating lookalike audiences based on our best converters. Setting up retargeting sequences for people who've visited our registration pages or engaged with our content. Choosing the right campaign objectives for each goal (awareness, lead gen, event registrations, etc.). Building and managing A/B tests for creative, copy, and targeting. Providing clear weekly reporting with plain-language takeaways, not just numbers.



Requirements

Must have:

Proven experience running Meta ads campaigns with demonstrable results (not just setup experience)

 Deep understanding of Meta Business Manager, Ad Account structure, and business verification

 Pixel installation and event tracking setup (including custom conversions)

 Custom audience and lookalike audience strategy

 Retargeting and multi-stage funnel logic

 Experience selecting and justifying campaign objectives based on business goals

 Strong written communication in English

 Ability to explain what's happening and why in plain language, not jargon



Nice to have:

Experience running ads for service businesses, events, or registration-based offerings

 Familiarity with MailerLite or other
 platforms for list-based audience uploads

 Landing page conversion analysis (identifying what's working and what isn't)

 Experience troubleshooting Meta business account issues or working with Meta support



Project details

Hours: ~5 hours per week (consistent, ongoing)

 Rate: Set hourly rate; include your rate in your application

 Work hours: Flexible with US Eastern time overlap preferred

 Timeline: Immediate start; first priority is account audit



How to apply

Video (preferred): Record a short video, 3 minutes max, answering these three questions:

Walk me through a Meta ads campaign you managed from setup to results. What was the goal, what audiences did you build, and what did performance look like?

If you discovered a client's Meta business account wasn't properly configured and ads couldn't run, what are the first three things you'd check and how would you approach fixing it?

Describe a retargeting sequence you've built. What triggered entry into the sequence and what was the goal at each stage?



Upload your video to Google Drive or Loom and include the link in your application. Keep it simple. I want to see how you think, not a production.



OR



: 



Include:

A brief overview of your Meta ads experience and types of businesses you've worked with

 2-3 results you've driven (even rough numbers are fine; just be honest)

 Your hourly rate

 A note on whether you've ever resolved a Meta business account setup issue and what that looked like

Please start your message with the word BLOOM so I know you read this in full.

Looking forward to hearing from you.





Kristen Noelle

 Co-founder, Venture to Bloom

title: Short-Term Rental Listings & Onboarding Manager
description:
# Full-Time Listings & Onboarding Manager (Hostaway / Airbnb / Booking.com)



We are a growing short-term rental management company looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Listings & Onboarding Manager to join our team full-time.



This role is focused on creating, optimizing, and managing property listings while ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for new properties. You will work closely with our sales team to transition newly signed properties into fully optimized, high-converting listings.



**Please note:** We are only interested in candidates with **at least 2 years of proven experience** managing short-term rental listings and property onboarding. This is not an entry-level position.



## Work Environment



This is a fast-paced, results-driven environment. We manage multiple property launches and listing updates each week, so the ability to work efficiently, prioritize tasks, and stay organized is essential.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of their responsibilities, solve problems independently, and execute tasks with minimal supervision. The successful candidate will be proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift quickly.



This is not a role for someone who requires constant direction or step-by-step guidance. Our systems, processes, and training are already in place, and we expect team members to learn quickly, take initiative, and consistently deliver high-quality work.



If you are someone who waits to be told what to do next, this role is probably not the right fit. We are looking for a self-starter who can identify what needs to be done, take action, and keep projects moving forward without constant oversight.



## Key Responsibilities



### Listing Creation & Optimization



* Create and publish high-quality property listings using **Hostaway** (our PMS platform)

* Build and optimize listings across Airbnb and Booking.com

* Write compelling property descriptions designed to maximize conversions and bookings

* Organize, edit, and optimize listing photos to showcase properties effectively

* Ensure photo order, captions, amenities, and property details follow company standards and industry best practices

* Continuously improve listing performance through optimization and updates

* Ensure all listings are accurate, complete, and optimized before going live



### Property Onboarding



* Work closely with the sales team after new properties are signed

* Attend onboarding calls with newly signed property owners

* Guide property owners through the onboarding process and gather all required information

* Collect and organize onboarding information from property owners

* Gather inventory details, property information, house rules, amenities, and required documentation

* Ensure all property data is complete, accurate, and ready for launch

* Coordinate the onboarding process from signed agreement to live listing

* Serve as the primary operational contact during the onboarding phase



### Listing Management & Quality Control



* Maintain listing accuracy across all channels

* Update listings as property details change

* Conduct regular quality checks to ensure consistency and compliance with company standards

* Monitor listings for missing information, photo issues, or optimization opportunities

* Ensure every listing meets company quality standards before going live



### Team Support & Operations



* Follow and maintain existing SOPs and workflows

* Assist team members with listing standards and onboarding procedures

* Help identify opportunities to improve efficiency and listing quality

* Support operational projects and ad-hoc tasks as needed



## Requirements



* **Minimum 2 years of experience** working with short-term rental listings and property onboarding

* **Hostaway experience is required**

* Experience managing listings on Airbnb and Booking.com

* Comfortable speaking directly with property owners on onboarding calls

* Strong understanding of listing optimization and conversion best practices

* Ability to write professional, engaging property descriptions

* Experience organizing and editing listing photos

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

* Strong written and spoken English

* Highly proactive and able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to take ownership of tasks

* Reliable, professional, and results-oriented

* Stable internet connection and professional work environment



## What We Offer



* Full-time monthly salary based on experience

* Performance-based bonuses

* Two days of paid training and onboarding at the start

* Established systems, processes, and support

* Long-term career growth opportunities as the company expands

* Opportunity to play a key role in building and scaling our property portfolio



## How to Apply



Please send your resume along with a short message that includes:



1. Why you are a good fit for this role

2. Your Hostaway experience

3. Your experience with Airbnb and Booking.com listings

4. Links to 2–3 listings you have personally created, optimized, or managed

5. A brief overview of your short-term rental experience

6. Confirmation that you have at least 2 years of relevant experience and are seeking a long-term full-time position



**Only serious and experienced candidates will be considered. If you do not have at least 2 years of relevant short-term rental listing and onboarding experience, please do not apply.**



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview.

title: Client Care Specialist (Dog Lovers, Neutral Accent, Not a Call Center, 9-5 ET)
description:
Are you a dog lover? If yes, this might be the job for you. You'll be working with US customers whose dogs take our herbal supplements, and helping those customers feel cared for, every single message and every single call.



This is a long-term role. If you're great, we want you with us for years, not months. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person.



One thing before you read any further: the schedule. This job runs 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. In the Philippines, that's 9:00pm to 5:00am. You'd be working through the night, every weeknight, for as long as you're with us. Night work fits some lives and not others, so be honest with yourself before you apply. And when you do apply, include one line in your
 confirming you understand this is overnight work.



Customer service experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'd rather hire a kind, hungry learner with zero call experience than an experienced agent who runs a script. If your English is clear and neutral and you truly love helping people and dogs, we'll teach you the rest.



We're a small pet supplement company. Our customers are devoted dog parents. Their dogs are all ages, some healthy, some dealing with health issues, and they reach out to us by
, text, and phone for help. We have a strong in-house knowledge base, and we'll train you on it thoroughly before you ever speak with a customer.



This is not a call center job



If your training is to apologize warmly and move on to the next call, this role will frustrate you. We never measure call times. We measure whether the customer got real help. Being sweet on the phone is the baseline here. The job is getting the customer a real answer.



We're a small, personable business where each customer gets dedicated, white-glove care. You'll have time to actually listen, and to remember a customer's dog's name from her last call. Every
 and every call gets treated like it matters.



Before you take calls alone, we'll train you for weeks on our products and our head herbalist's teaching, and you'll pass a product knowledge check in your first 30 days. When a dog mom asks how other customers get a picky senior dog to take her herbs, we expect an answer from that training. When you don't know, the answer is "I'll find out and call you back today." Then you find out, and you call back. Part of the job is knowing the line: ordering and product questions you handle yourself, deeper health questions get booked into a consult with our herbalist.



You won't be thrown to the wolves. While you're learning, you can pass any hard call to our head herbalist, then listen to the recording afterward to hear how she handled it. We train this deeply because we want you here for years.



What you'll do



- Read and reply to customer service
s

- Reply to customer text messages

- Help customers place orders, track shipments, and resolve order issues

- Set up appointments with our head herbalist for customers who want a deeper conversation about their dog

- Study our knowledge base and keep learning. The more you know, the more you can help.

- Answer phone calls when they come in. Some days are busier than others, but whenever the phone rings, that's your first priority.



Who you are



- Your English is clear with a neutral accent. Have past US customers ever been surprised to find out you weren't based in the US? If yes, please tell us about it in your application. Most of our customers are older American women (ages 40-65). They need to understand you the first time, every time.

- Warm and patient on the phone. You sound like someone who could comfort a worried grandma.

- A genuine dog lover. You'll be talking about dogs all day, every day: their names, their ages, their conditions, their quirks.

- Hungry to learn. We'll hand you real training on herbal pet care, and we want someone who actually wants that knowledge and will use it to help people.

- Kind during hard conversations. Sometimes a customer will tell you her dog was just diagnosed with something serious, or has just passed away. We don't expect you to have medical answers. We want you to be kind, slow down, listen, and let her know you understand.

- Reliable. You show up on time, you follow up, you finish what you start, you don't drop the ball.

- Comfortable with technology. You don't need to know our specific tools. We'll train you on those. If you already know any customer service, e-commerce, or admin tools, list them in your application.



Requirements



- Customer service experience helps but is optional. Clear, neutral English is required.

- Reliable home internet with at least 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 50ms, on a wired Ethernet connection (not WiFi alone).

- A quiet home office. No background noise on calls: no roosters, no traffic, no kids, no neighbors. Backup power or a hotspot in case of outages is a strong plus.

- Quality USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone

- Modern computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old)

- Available 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. That's 9:00pm to 5:00am Philippines time. Please only apply if you can genuinely commit to that overnight schedule, long-term.

- ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile. We only review applications from ID-verified accounts.



Nice to have



- You've worked for a small US-based e-commerce brand answering US customers, and those customers never realized you weren't based in the US. This is the experience we value most.

- Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms,
 tools). List anything you've used.

- Other work skills that could help a small company: bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well.



Schedule and pay



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Paid twice monthly

- Long-term role. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person.



How to apply (please read carefully, incomplete applications will not be reviewed)



In your
, please include all 5 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction, not by who applied first.



1. At the very top of your
, write the word "Buddy" in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.)



2. Record a 1 to 3 minute video covering the four prompts below, and get it to us any way you want: attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works.



3. Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the
, also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi.



4. List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software you have used (for example: Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, anything you actually know). If you've never used any, write "none yet." That's an acceptable answer.



5. List one or more previous employers, teachers, clients, or anyone you've worked for who can speak to your work and character. Customer service references are best if you have them. One is fine if that's all you have.



Video prompts (1 to 3 minutes total, single take, no editing)



Cover all four, in any order. No script. Just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer.



1. Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume.



2. Tell us about any experience helping people. Customer service if you have it, but teaching, retail, nursing, caring for family, anything where someone needed you and you showed up. If you can, tell us about one specific person you helped and what you did for them.



3. Tell us about a dog you've loved. Yours, a family dog, a neighbor's dog, any dog that mattered to you. What was their name, and what do you remember about them?



4. What else can you do? Customer service is the main job, but extra skills are gold to a small team like ours. Bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well. If helping customers is your only area, just say so. That's a fine answer.



Tips:



- Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality.

- Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you.

- 1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. Going under or over is a soft red flag. It tells us how you'd manage time on a real call.



If your application is missing any of items 1 to 5, we will not review it. We're being strict because we're hiring carefully, and because the right person deserves a fair, fast review.



After we watch your video and read your application, we'll reach out if we like you. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance, and we'll reimburse the fee.

title: Senior Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
I run a residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California, and am looking for an experienced residential appraisal writer to join the team. The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for an experienced and senior level residential report writer to join our team.



Your role will be to do the following:

1. Complete the entire residential appraisal report after the appraiser has provided you with the inspection information and comparables. This includes all the commentary, adjustments, and all other parts of the report. We will provide training on how we specifically expect the commentary and adjustments based on our own personal preferences, however you are expected to already have this type of experience working for other appraisers.

2. Review the work of other report writers on our team, provide feedback, and help train newer report writers on our team. You are expected to act as the "last line of defense" of the report before it is sent to the appraiser for their final review before submission. As such, we expect you to be able to review the report, find any issues, correct these issues, and then send to the appraiser a near perfect report.



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have worked for a US residential appraiser

2. You have experience performing data entry for residential properties in the US

3. You have experience creating the 1004MC, selecting comparables, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, making adjustments to the sales grid, and making commentary for the addendum.

4. Ideally, you have experience managing other appraisal report writers.



If you don't have experience in writing commentary or the addendum, or do not have experience with making adjustments on the sales grid, we would still like to hear from you as we have a different job that would fit your experience better.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

We run a portfolio of e-commerce webshops powered by Google Ads. Each store carries thousands of products, and we add hundreds of new ones every single week. Our edge is speed and selection: we find products people are already searching for on Google, list them fast, and let demand do the rest.



We sell primarily into the German market (DACH region), so a deep, instinctive feel for what German consumers want — and what they'll want next — is the heart of this role.



The role

We're looking for an experienced Product Researcher who can consistently spot products that will trend in the coming months before they peak — and validate that real Google search demand exists behind them. You'll feed our pipeline with a steady, high-quality stream of products that have proven search volume and rising interest in Germany.



This is a research-and-judgment role, not a data-entry role. We need someone whose product picks reliably convert into search traffic and sales.



What you'll do

- Research and identify products with rising or established Google search demand in the German/DACH market.

- Forecast upcoming trends and seasonal demand 1–6 months ahead, and flag products before they saturate.

- Validate demand using tools like Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, 
, and search volume / keyword data.

- Deliver a weekly shortlist of vetted products (target: hundreds per week across stores) with search volume, seasonality, and competition notes.

- Track competitors, marketplaces (
, Otto, Kaufland, 
), and German social/shopping trends.

- Work closely with our Google Ads and listing teams so winning products get to market fast.



What you bring

- Proven track record in e-commerce product research, trend spotting, or dropshipping/retail sourcing — with results you can point to.

- Deep knowledge of the German market: consumer behaviour, seasonality, language nuances, and what sells in DACH.

- Hands-on skill with Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, and search-volume tools; comfortable reading keyword and demand data.

- An eye for timing — you understand the difference between a fad, a trend, and an evergreen.

- High output without sacrificing quality; you can work at the pace of "hundreds of products a week."

- Self-directed, data-driven, and comfortable in a fast-moving remote team.



Nice to have

- Experience with Google Ads / Shopping campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopify or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of German marketplace ecosystems and import/sourcing channels.



How to apply

Send us:

- A short note on your product-research experience and the German market.

- 3 products you believe will trend in DACH over the next 3 months — with the Google search data that backs your pick.

Your availability and rate/salary expectation.



The 3-product test is the part we read first. Show us how you think.

title: Hiring Video Editor(s) for Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand
description:
We are hiring video editor(s) for a fast-growing DTC health brand.

What's in it for you:

- Competitive pay based on skill, experience, and output.

- Consistent long-term remote work.

- We accept applicants worldwide.

- Full-time Monday-Friday roles available.

- Weekend coverage roles also available.

- Clear direction, references, examples, and briefs, especially in the beginning.

- Zero micromanagement if the work is high-quality and delivered on time.

- Work with a fast-moving DTC team.

- Opportunity to learn direct-response ecommerce creative.

- Strong performers can grow into higher-paid roles like Senior Editor, Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead.



This is not a dead-end editing role. The best editor on the team can grow into a Lead Editor role and eventually help manage other editors. More ownership means more opportunity.



What you'll work on:

- Short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta, and other paid/social platforms.

- UGC-style video ads.

- VSL-style creatives.

- Product-focused videos.

- Hook variations and cutdowns.

- AI-assisted assets, B-roll, animations, graphics, and visual enhancements.

- Ecommerce ad creatives built around pacing, clarity, retention, and storytelling.



What we're looking for:

- Strong video editing skills.

- Strong sense of pacing, retention, captions, visual rhythm, and storytelling.

- You understand TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, and modern social content.

- You can follow direction closely and match the style/vibe of provided references.

- You can work fast without making sloppy mistakes.

- You have good English comprehension and understand the nuance/vibe of scripts.

- You are comfortable using AI tools or willing to learn them fast.

- You are reliable, responsive, and can hit deadlines.

- You are coachable and hungry to improve.



Big bonus points:

- You have edited ecommerce, DTC, health, or performance-marketing videos before.

- You understand direct-response creative.

- You have worked with 7-9 figure brands before.

- You have edited ads that performed well.

- You can explain why a hook, cut, caption, or pacing choice worked.

- You have experience with VSLs, YouTube editing, creator content, or high-retention long-form editing.

- You want to grow into a Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead role.



Important:

We do not care about flashy transitions just for the sake of looking fancy.



We care about edits that make people stop scrolling, keep watching, understand the message, trust the product, and take action.



Async screening:

We do not do intro calls for the first screen.



You will write a short breakdown in this form. Bonus points if you also include a voice-note link. Double bonus points if you include a short video walkthrough link.



How to apply:

Fill out the form below.

Apply here:





Include your best work, any ecommerce/direct-response/ad examples if you have them, a short written breakdown of why an edit/ad worked, optional voice/video breakdown links, what types of videos you are strongest at, your tools/software, your availability, and why you are the best person for this role.

Create testing plans for ad copy, landing pages, product groups, audiences and bidding strategies.

Work with internal marketing, content and product teams to improve campaign assets and conversion performance.

Provide regular reporting with clear insights, actions and recommendations.

Lead paid ads planning for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns and new brand growth.

Support the team with paid search knowledge, campaign standards and best-practice processes.



Key Requirements

Strong experience managing Google Ads for eCommerce businesses.

Strong experience with Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns.

Experience with Microsoft Bing Ads.

Proven ability to manage large advertising budgets and optimise for ROAS and profitable revenue growth.

Strong understanding of campaign structure, keyword strategy, bidding, audience targeting and conversion tracking.

Ability to analyse campaign data and turn insights into clear actions.

Experience working with multiple brands, product categories and customer segments.

Strong understanding of Google Merchant Centre and product feed optimisation.

Ability to create clear reports and communicate performance results to management.

Management-level experience with the ability to lead strategy and guide execution.

Organised, proactive and able to work independently.



Preferred Skills

Advanced experience with Performance Max campaign segmentation and optimisation.

Experience managing both B2B and B2C eCommerce campaigns.

Experience with Google Merchant Centre, Google Analytics, Search Console and conversion tracking.

Experience with Microsoft Merchant Centre and Bing Shopping campaigns.

Understanding of product margin, pricing strategy and profitability-based campaign management.

AI-first mindset, with the ability to use AI tools to improve advertising efficiency, reporting and optimisation.

Ability to work effectively with internal teams and external contractors.

Experience working across multiple eCommerce brands.

Strong understanding of landing page performance, CRO and digital advertising funnels.

Experience creating SOPs, campaign structures and reporting systems for paid advertising teams.



Please send your resume, portfolio or examples of previous Google Ads and Bing Ads campaign work.

In your application, please include examples of eCommerce campaigns you have managed, advertising budgets handled, campaign types used and results achieved, including ROAS, revenue growth or other key performance improvements where possible.
