title: Product Researcher — Trend & Demand Specialist (German Market)
description:
About us

We run a portfolio of e-commerce webshops powered by Google Ads. Each store carries thousands of products, and we add hundreds of new ones every single week. Our edge is speed and selection: we find products people are already searching for on Google, list them fast, and let demand do the rest.



We sell primarily into the German market (DACH region), so a deep, instinctive feel for what German consumers want — and what they'll want next — is the heart of this role.



The role

We're looking for an experienced Product Researcher who can consistently spot products that will trend in the coming months before they peak — and validate that real Google search demand exists behind them. You'll feed our pipeline with a steady, high-quality stream of products that have proven search volume and rising interest in Germany.



This is a research-and-judgment role, not a data-entry role. We need someone whose product picks reliably convert into search traffic and sales.



What you'll do

- Research and identify products with rising or established Google search demand in the German/DACH market.

- Forecast upcoming trends and seasonal demand 1–6 months ahead, and flag products before they saturate.

- Validate demand using tools like Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, 
, and search volume / keyword data.

- Deliver a weekly shortlist of vetted products (target: hundreds per week across stores) with search volume, seasonality, and competition notes.

- Track competitors, marketplaces (
, Otto, Kaufland, 
), and German social/shopping trends.

- Work closely with our Google Ads and listing teams so winning products get to market fast.



What you bring

- Proven track record in e-commerce product research, trend spotting, or dropshipping/retail sourcing — with results you can point to.

- Deep knowledge of the German market: consumer behaviour, seasonality, language nuances, and what sells in DACH.

- Hands-on skill with Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, and search-volume tools; comfortable reading keyword and demand data.

- An eye for timing — you understand the difference between a fad, a trend, and an evergreen.

- High output without sacrificing quality; you can work at the pace of "hundreds of products a week."

- Self-directed, data-driven, and comfortable in a fast-moving remote team.



Nice to have

- Experience with Google Ads / Shopping campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopify or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of German marketplace ecosystems and import/sourcing channels.



How to apply

Send us:

- A short note on your product-research experience and the German market.

- 3 products you believe will trend in DACH over the next 3 months — with the Google search data that backs your pick.

Your availability and rate/salary expectation.



The 3-product test is the part we read first. Show us how you think.

 or structured feedback workflows

title: Customer Success & AI Onboarding Manager
description:
# Customer Success & AI Onboarding Manager



***Required Coverage: 9am to 5pm PST - Must keep US hours



## About The Role



We are looking for a Customer Success & AI Onboarding Manager who will take ownership of new clients from onboarding through successful launch and stabilization.



This is not a virtual assistant position.



You will be the primary point of contact for clients, responsible for guiding them through onboarding, building and testing AI voice agents, configuring scheduling systems, running go-live meetings, proactively identifying issues, and ensuring clients have an excellent experience.



The right person is highly organized, technically curious, an excellent communicator, and obsessed with details. You don't need to know every platform already, but you must be able to learn quickly, troubleshoot independently, and figure things out.



If a client is confused, stuck, or at risk of becoming frustrated, you are the person who notices first and takes action.



## What You'll Own



### Client Success & Communication



* Lead onboarding and implementation calls via Zoom

* Become the primary point of contact for clients during onboarding

* Keep projects moving and eliminate bottlenecks

* Follow up proactively without being reminded

* Identify at-risk clients and resolve concerns before they become problems

* Run go-live meetings and launch coordination

* Train clients on how to manage their systems after launch



### AI Agent Buildout & Optimization



* Build Retell AI voice agents using onboarding forms, websites, and call-flow requirements

* Use ChatGPT and internal templates to create and improve prompts

* Configure transfers, routing, knowledge bases, and function calls

* Review call recordings and continuously improve agent performance

* Identify conversation failures and implement prompt updates



### Scheduling & Platform Configuration



* Configure Cal.com scheduling systems

* Connect and test Google Calendar integrations

* Set up availability, event types, reminders, and booking workflows

* Train clients on managing bookings and schedules

* Troubleshoot scheduling issues independently



### QA & Launch Management



* Perform comprehensive testing before launch

* Validate booking flows, transfers, notifications, and edge cases

* Monitor client accounts after go-live

* Listen to call recordings regularly

* Detect issues before clients report them

* Maintain launch checklists and quality standards



### Technical Problem Solving



* Configure call forwarding and phone routing systems

* Navigate unfamiliar phone systems and software platforms independently

* Research solutions using documentation, ChatGPT, and available resources

* Escalate only when necessary

* Coordinate advanced integrations with our Lead AI Engineer



### Operations & Documentation



* Maintain onboarding pipelines in GoHighLevel

* Track projects and tasks in Airtable

* Document client configurations and launch details

* Maintain change logs and implementation notes

* Keep client records accurate and up to date



## Required Skills



* Exceptional spoken and written English

* Strong client-facing communication skills

* Experience leading Zoom meetings professionally

* Outstanding organizational skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability

* Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly

* Experience using ChatGPT effectively

* Strong attention to detail

* Ownership mentality and follow-through



## Strongly Preferred



* Retell experience

* Cal.com experience

* GoHighLevel experience

* Airtable experience

* SaaS onboarding experience

* Customer Success experience

* Technical Account Management experience

* AI voice agent experience



## What Success Looks Like



* Clients launch on time with minimal founder involvement

* Clients feel informed, supported, and confident throughout onboarding

* Issues are identified before clients discover them

* Agents perform reliably and improve over time

* Scheduling and integrations work consistently

* Clients remain engaged, active, and satisfied



## Hiring Process



### Stage 1: Paid Skills Assessment



You will receive a sample client onboarding package and be asked to complete:



* Retell prompt draft

* Scheduling setup plan

* QA checklist

* Client communication response examples

* Issue investigation exercise



### Stage 2: Live Interview



You will participate in:



* Client onboarding roleplay

* Troubleshooting exercise

* Communication assessment



### Stage 3: Supervised Trial



You will assist with one real client onboarding under supervision.



## To Apply



Please include:



* A short summary of your relevant experience

* Loom videos demonstrating previous work (if available)

* Confirmation that you can work 10am–3pm Pacific Time Monday–Thursday

* Your hourly rate

* Examples of customer onboarding, customer success, technical support, or implementation work

* A brief explanation of a time you solved a problem using a platform you had never used before

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: Executive Administrative Specialist — Compliance & Operations Support
description:
Executive Administrative Specialist — Compliance & Operations Support



Remote · UAE Law Firm · Full-Time (UAE Hours)



About Us

Our lawyers work virtually, and our firm is built on precision, professionalism, and trust. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a seasoned, detail-driven professional to serve as the administrative and operational backbone of the firm — someone who thrives in a structured, document-intensive, and confidential environment.

The regulatory checks themselves are carried out by our dedicated compliance reviewers — your role is to make their work seamless by owning everything around it. title: Business / Finance Controller (Remote)
description:
WDM | E-commerce on Bol | Remote | 3–4 days per week (path to full-time as we grow)



We're a Dutch e-commerce business selling on the Bol marketplace. We're small, we move fast, and we've automated a lot of the heavy lifting, including our P&L and cashflow, which now run on AI-driven models. So we're not looking for someone to put reports together. We already have the numbers. What we don't have yet is the person who looks at those numbers and d
 what we should actually do about them. That's the role.



You'd work directly with me, the founder. When margin slips, you're the one who figures out why and what to change. When we're sitting on overstock, you're the one who d
 what to clear, at what price, and when, and backs it with the maths. When our models spit out a suggestion, you're the one who checks whether it's actually right before we act on it. 



What you'd own

-Margin. Track it across products and channels, work out what's driving it up or down, and drive the changes that protect it.

-Commercial decisions. Turn the data and the model output into real calls on pricing, promotions, assortment, and inventory.

-Overstock. Treat it as a financial decision, not a guess. Put a number on it and d
 how and when to clear it.

-A check on the models. Pressure-test what our AI finance tools produce before we trust it. The model proposes, you validate, I d
.

-SKU profitability. Find the winners and the quiet money-losers, and turn that into pricing and assortment decisions.

The formal finance side. VAT, year-end, the accountant, compliance, and being in the room for any banking or financing conversations.

-Cashflow. Keep an eye on the position, flag risks early, and understand how purchasing and stock decisions hit working capital.





What it isn't

A heads-up so we don't waste each other's time. 

This isn't a bookkeeping or monthly-reporting job, our systems already handle that. 

You also won't be building or fixing the data pipelines; we have a data analyst who owns data accuracy, and you'd work alongside them as an equal. 

Note: it might be that you spot these and work allong side the data analist to tackle bugs.



Nobody's going to hand you a task list. 

You're the one making the calls.





Who we're hoping to find

The thing that's rare, and the thing we really want, is someone who has the Skills to equally handle P&L/Cashflow, can make SKU-level margin breakdowns, and can make decision messy stock data.

Most finance people are only comfortable with the first; most data people only the last. 

We need someone who bridges all three.



Example of decision comming from this

-Pay of loans x amount of weeks

-Push these products to gain turnover or lower overstock

-Invest in these categories or when we are ready to invest in growth 

-Prep for Q4 financially and on SKU level. 

-Tips on lowering Opperational expenditure (where is the biggest cash leak and a step by step on how to fix it)







Marketplace experience matters to us more than a long corporate finance CV. 

If you understand how fulfilment costs, returns, ad spend, and tied-up inventory eat into margin, you'll be of great impact from week one.



We care more about how you think than how many years you've done it. 

A sharp person with three to five years and real commercial instinct beats someone with a longer history who's only ever produced reports. 

What we're really after is someone who's owned decisions, not just numbers, and who's comfortable telling me I'm wrong when the data says so.



You'll need to be fluent in English, happy working remotely with a few hours of daily overlap with European time, and comfortable working with AI-driven finance tools and a modern e-commerce stack.





What you get out of it

-Real ownership from day one. You're not slotting into a process, you're shaping how we make decisions. 

-The finance and data side of the business is yours to lead.

-A direct line to the founder. No layers, no politics. You bring the thinking, we d
 together, and you see your calls play out in the business fast.

-Room to grow. This starts at 3–4 days a week and grows into a full-time leadership seat as we scale. Get this right and the role grows with the company.

-A company that invests in you. We're built on quality, not just in our products and service, but in the life of our team. We back that up with a monthly health bonus you can put toward whatever keeps you well, gym, better sleep, whatever works for you. If we expect quality from you, we owe you the conditions to deliver it.

-Remote, wherever you are, with just a few hours of daily overlap with European time.

-USD $15–$20 an hour to start, with real room to move up as you prove yourself.



How to apply

Skip the long CV for now. Instead, I'd like a few things in your own words.



First, tell me how you'd think about this: say we've got a chunk of capital tied up in overstock. How would you d
 what to clear, at what price, and when?

I'm not after a perfect answer, you don't know our data yet, I just want to see how your mind works on it.



Then share a quick story about a time you pushed back on a number, a model, or a boss, and how it played out. 

And tell me a little about what you've done before, and what made you want this role specifically.



One last thing. We're after real A-players, and A-players like to work with other A-players. 

So if you've read this and thought yes, this is me, apply. 



I'm looking forward to reading it.

title: Freelance Inventory Planner — Ecommerce
description:
Hi! We are a fast-growing Dutch premium ecommerce brand selling scented products online. We are scaling quickly and need someone who can help us stay on top of our inventory, so we never run out of stock.



What this job is:

- We are looking for a freelance inventory planner who can build a forecasting system and give us weekly advice on our stock levels.

- This is not a supply chain management role. You will not contact suppliers. You will not place orders. We handle all of that ourselves.



Your job is simple:

- Receive data from us (Shopify exports, current stock levels, lead time updates)

- Build a model that calculates when we need to reorder each product

- Tell us what to order, how much, and when, before we run out



Phase 1 — Build the system (first 2–4 weeks, approximately 8–10 hours per week)

- Aalyse our currect system

- Map all our products and current stock levels

- Analyze sales velocity per SKU

- Build a reorder model in Excel or Google Sheets (or something like that) that calculates reorder points, safety stock, and projected stock-out dates

- Account for variable supplier lead times, we will always tell you when lead times change

- Deliver a clean, easy-to-read dashboard that shows us what action to take each week

- Document everything so we always understand the model



Phase 2 — Ongoing management (after setup, approximately 2–4 hours per week)**

- Update the forecast 1–2 times per week based on our latest sales data

- Send us a short weekly update: what needs to be ordered, what is at risk, what is fine

- Adjust forecasts when we inform you about upcoming sales, promotions, or lead time changes

- Keep the model accurate and up to date



Important: We always inform you about any changes that affect inventory: new sales campaigns, changed lead times, new products. You take that input and update the forecast accordingly.



What we are looking for

- Experience in inventory planning or demand forecasting for an ecommerce or product-based business

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills — you must be comfortable building formulas, reorder models, and dashboards

- Experience working with Shopify data (sales reports, inventory exports)

- Clear and structured communicator — your weekly update must be simple and direct, not a complex report

- Reliable and proactive — you flag risks before they become problems

If you are:



Sales-driven
